text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, they have a limited-time drink!
A custard milkshake~ It looks so yummy~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, it looks pretty sweet...
I've gained a bit of weight recently too...
Must resist, must resist—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If you want to drink it, why don't you?
Why do you feel the need to hold back?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Well... if I gain weight, it'll affect my
running... so I really want to keep myself
at my ideal weight..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I suppose it can't be helped. In that case,
I shall cast a diet magic spell on you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I'm honored!
Sweep-san, please do~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... S-Sweep-san...
Where are you going...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Location is crucial for this magic. You need to drink the "Pure Droplets" found deep within the forest!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're here!
Craft, draw some of that spring water and drink up!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I drank it!
This will help me diet, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—Not yet.
You make ten round trips to the forest entrance, drink ten drops of dew,
and then chant the incantation. That is how this magic is completed.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Alright, 9 more round trips to go, off you go!

Thanks to Sweep Tosho's magic(?),
Rhein Kraft successfully lost weight.
